objection.quote: XY aims to realise a refinement whose pieces can be perfectly matched into pairs of equal length except for a single leftover piece of length \(1\). Such a multiset has \(D=1\).
objection.witness: What must be proved for all cases: for EVERY multiset L of total S = 2^{n+1}-1 arising from Liu's at most n marks, an explicit choice of at most n additional cuts yielding D(M) <= 1 (e.g. a subset-sum/pigeonhole gap bound plus a pairing construction). The quoted passage only states a target shape (paired pieces plus one leftover of length 1) and the following text admits the counting fails ('is exactly the number of internal breaks, which is 2n; but starting from an already partially cut stick the residual number of cuts required is at most n'), with no proof that n cuts suffice from an arbitrary Liu partition; the section elsewhere records its own contradiction ('This appears contradictory unless...') and closes with checks for n = 1, 2 only.
objection.load_bearing: Tightness of c_n = 2^n/(2^{n+1}-1) rests entirely on Theorem C; without a construction valid for every Liu partition and every n the upper bound is unestablished.
